break away from: He finally managed to break away from his old habits and started a healthier life.
他终于设法摆脱了旧习惯，开始过上更健康的生活。
the Union Jack: The Union Jack flew proudly above the building during the national celebration.
国庆庆典期间，英国国旗骄傲地飘扬在大楼上方。
to one’s credit: To her credit, she admitted her mistake and apologized at once.
值得赞扬的是，她承认了自己的错误并立即道歉。
take the place of: Robots may one day take the place of humans in many dangerous jobs.
有一天机器人可能会在许多危险工作中代替人类。
break down: Our car broke down on the way to the airport, so we missed the flight.
我们的车在去机场的路上抛锚了，所以我们错过了航班。
St Paul’s Cathedral: Thousands of visitors come to see St Paul's Cathedral every year.
每年有成千上万的游客前来参观圣保罗大教堂。
Westminster Abbey: Many famous writers and scientists are buried in Westminster Abbey.
许多著名的作家和科学家安葬在威斯敏斯特教堂。
Buckingham Palace: The tourists waited outside Buckingham Palace to watch the changing of the guard.
游客们等在白金汉宫外观看卫兵换岗仪式。
Highgate Cemetery: That famous thinker is buried in Highgate Cemetery in the north of London.
那位著名的思想家安葬在伦敦北部的海格特墓地。
jet lag: It took him two days to get over the jet lag after the long flight.
长途飞行后，他花了两天时间才倒过时差。
be back on one’s feet: After a month of rest, she was back on her feet and returned to work.
休息一个月后，她完全康复并重新回去上班了。
safety belt: Please fasten your safety belt before the plane takes off.
飞机起飞前请系好安全带。
lose sight of…: In the thick fog, the sailors soon lost sight of the shore.
在浓雾中，水手们很快就看不见海岸了。
sweep up: After the party, we had to sweep up the broken glass on the floor.
聚会结束后，我们得打扫掉地板上的碎玻璃。
slide into: The thief slid into the room without making any noise.
小偷悄无声息地溜进了房间。
speed up: The train began to speed up as it left the station.
火车驶出车站后开始加速。
concentrate on: I can't concentrate on my homework with all this noise outside.
外面这么吵，我无法集中精力做作业。
accuse…of: Nobody should accuse him of being lazy, because he works harder than anyone.
谁都不该指责他懒惰，因为他比任何人都努力。
so as to (do sth): She got up early so as to catch the first bus to school.
她起得很早，为了赶上第一班公交车去上学。
ahead of: The red car was several meters ahead of us on the mountain road.
在山路上，那辆红色汽车在我们前面好几米。
fall ill: He fell ill the day before the exam and couldn't take it.
考试前一天他生病了，没法参加考试。
electric shock: Never touch the wire with wet hands, or you may get an electric shock.
千万不要用湿手碰电线，否则你可能会触电。
squeeze out: She squeezed out the last drops of toothpaste from the tube.
她把牙膏管里最后一点牙膏挤了出来。
in place: Everything was already in place when the guests arrived at the hall.
客人到达大厅时，一切都已经就绪。
a number of: A number of students in our class joined the school basketball team.
我们班有不少学生加入了学校篮球队。
put one’s hands on: I can't put my hands on my dictionary; I have looked for it everywhere.
我找不到我的词典了，我到处都找过了。
Joan of Arc: Joan of Arc is remembered as a brave heroine in French history.
圣女贞德作为法国历史上勇敢的女英雄被人们铭记。
Elizabeth Fry: Elizabeth Fry spent her whole life helping poor prisoners and their children.
伊丽莎白·弗赖伊一生都在帮助贫穷的囚犯和他们的孩子。
China Welfare Institute: The China Welfare Institute has helped thousands of children since it was founded.
中国福利基金会自成立以来已经帮助了成千上万的儿童。
Jane Goodall: Jane Goodall studied chimpanzees in Africa for more than forty years.
简·古道尔在非洲研究黑猩猩四十多年。
human being: Language is what makes each human being different from other animals.
语言是使每个人类区别于其他动物的东西。
Jody Williams: Jody Williams won the Nobel Peace Prize for her work against landmines.
乔迪·威廉斯因反对地雷的工作获得了诺贝尔和平奖。
Gombe National Park: The scientist spent years observing wild chimpanzees in Gombe National Park.
这位科学家多年在贡贝国家公园观察野生黑猩猩。
move off: The bus moved off just as we reached the stop.
我们刚到车站，公共汽车就开走了。
lead a…life: My grandparents lead a quiet and happy life in the countryside.
我的祖父母在乡下过着宁静幸福的生活。
crowd in: Memories of my childhood crowded in when I saw the old photo.
看到那张老照片时，童年的回忆涌上心头。
look down on: Never look down on others just because they are different from you.
千万不要因为别人与你不同就瞧不起他们。
look down upon: People who look down upon the poor often show their own ignorance.
瞧不起穷人的人往往暴露出自己的无知。
refer to: You can refer to your notes if you forget the main points.
如果忘了要点，你可以查阅笔记。
by chance: I met my primary school teacher by chance in the bookstore.
我在书店碰巧遇到了我的小学老师。
